title: Agent group policy plan
description: What level_policy_plan and level_policy_status return, and what basalt access enroll --json and basalt access sync --json print: per guarded table, the row-level security policies the enrolled role's agent group needs (owner decision AA-17). The admin confirms once; record_level_policies stores each table's fingerprint. CONTRACT.md, Access and audit, Agent groups and mirrored policies.

planHash.description: Lowercase hex sha256 of the plan; record_level_policies refuses a plan the catalog no longer matches (BS012 PLAN_CHANGED).

table.description: schema.table as Postgres quotes it (quote_ident on each part).

status.description: Against what was last recorded; NOT_SYNCED before the first sync of this table.

name.description: <prefix>_lvl_<oid>_cur (the currency guard every table gets), <prefix>_lvl_<oid>_b<cmd> (the bound per command on a MIRRORED table, cmd select, insert, update or delete), <prefix>_lvl_<oid>_all for ALL_ROWS, or <prefix>_lvl_<oid>_<8 or more hex of sha256(source name)>; for a KEEP entry of a policy that applies to the agents as written, that policy's own name.

source.description: The source policy's name (a policy that applies to the agents as written included); null for the currency guard, the bounds and the ALL_ROWS policy.

permissive.description: false: AS RESTRICTIVE, which can never be left out.

sql.description: The CREATE POLICY statement the admin runs: the currency guard, a copy with the level_current guard ANDed into each clause, or USING (false) for a marked restrictive source without a replacement; null for OMIT and for KEEP of a policy Basalt does not write.

action.description: What the plan does with the entry. OMIT: a marked permissive source left out. KEEP: unchanged, or a policy that applies to the agents as written (TO PUBLIC, TO <prefix>_agents, or another role the agents have the privileges of), listed because the fingerprint covers it (sql null).

reviewNeeded.description: Marks from an allow list over the stored expression tree. IDENTITY: a CURRENT_USER-like value. SUBQUERY: a sublink. FUNCTION: any function reached (operators, casts, I/O coercions, aggregates included) that is not in pg_catalog and IMMUTABLE, nor one of the STABLE clock functions. A marked restrictive source, and a marked restrictive policy that applies to the agents as written, gets a restrictive USING (false) copy; a marked permissive source is left out (action OMIT) and left out of the bound; unless the admin gives a replacement, which then also joins the bound.

replacement.description: The admin's own expression for a marked copy, written for the group; null when Basalt writes the copy (or false, or leaves it out). The fingerprint covers it.
